newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ICI Australia says has pesticide insurance.
newsitem.headline: ICI Australia says has pesticide insurance.

text.p: ICI Australia Ltd on Wednesday said it believed it was fully insured for any damages that might arise from a cotton-contanimation case involving one of the company's pesticides.
ICI Australia managing director Philip Weickhardt told reporters that the company had so far not made an estimate of contingent liability.

The company's chairman, Ben Lochtenberg, earlier told a meeting of shareholders that ICI Australia did not accept liability and was consideraing an appeal to Tuesday's judgement in the Federal Court in Sydney.
"In the event we were found liable and damages were awarded against us, we believe that they are covered by our insurance," Weickhardt said.
ICI's parent, ICI Plc, remains exposed to some liability even though it plans to sell its 62.4 percent stake in the Australian offshoot.
